tools.name: marketplace_describe
tools.description: Read seven-product marketplace status, MCP interface and payment rules.

tools.name: marketplace_list_offers
tools.description: List the offers currently sold, with deliverables, availability and prices.

tools.name: marketplace_get_offer
tools.description: Get a single specialist service's exact machine-readable scope and boundaries.

tools.name: marketplace_quote
tools.description: Get an honest price/availability response; hypothetical prices are not charges.

tools.name: marketplace_mpp_purchase_instructions
tools.description: Get the real Stripe MPP SPT checkout URL, required JSON schema, tax-gated availability and order retrieval steps.

tools.name: marketplace_prepare_mpp_checkout
tools.description: Prepare exact JSON and SHA-256-bound purchase URL for an approved agent wallet. Does not charge.

tools.name: marketplace_preflight
tools.description: Free service-fit checklist using a nonconfidential scope summary; no execution.

tools.name: marketplace_reconcile_synthetic
tools.description: A real, limited deterministic reconciliation on fictional numbers, NO customer data.

tools.name: marketplace_analyze_public_inventory
tools.description:
Evidence-based free preview on explicitly authorized PUBLIC stock IDs/prices.

    Two supplied snapshots only. No web scraping, VIN owner lookup, private data,
    forecasting, purchases, persistent storage or client-specific Reserve access.
    Paid report supports larger input and private buyer-o

tools.name: marketplace_find_agents
tools.description:
Search ONLY operator-published local agent metadata; no execution, writes or payment.

    Ranking/reputation are tentative off-chain heuristics, never verified identities,
    registry sync, certified outcomes or on-chain ERC-8004 attestations.

tools.name: marketplace_agent_profile
tools.description:
Inspect an operator-published agent's public metadata and unverified feedback totals.

    No unreviewed agent, individual evaluator record or private job is exposed.

tools.name: marketplace_request_order
tools.description: Create an unpaid human-approved scope inquiry for ANY of the seven offers.

tools.name: marketplace_attach_synthetic_fixture
tools.description: Attach immutable fictional rows under the buyer's private order capability.

tools.name: marketplace_attach_public_inventory
tools.description:
Attach public non-PII inventory prices to a privately authorized order.

    First-product limited beta. No private customer data or personal identifiers.
    Default OFF; restricted to Stripe TEST until launch conditions are approved.

tools.name: marketplace_get_order
tools.description: Capability-protected order status and report after separate verified payment.

tools.name: marketplace_begin_checkout
tools.description: Release Stripe-hosted fixed-price payment link ONLY after merchant/seller approval.

tools.name: marketplace_machine_test_pay
tools.description:
Authorized agent-only $1 Stripe TEST payment using a synthetic test method.

    Disabled unless separately opted in. Never processes live credentials.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "marketplace_machine_test_pay" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Authorized agent-only $1 Stripe TEST payment using a synthetic test method. Disabled unless separately opted in. Never processes live credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "marketplace_list_offers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List all seven product names, deliverables, availability and price proposals." → after: "List the offers currently sold, with deliverables, availability and prices."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
